lines.trans: Kaiwen, you can come right back to work? That fast?
I mean wonderful — recovering that fast is truly great!
Xiaogu, the chief editor's office only seconded you here because Kaiwen fell ill.
Now that Kaiwen is back, the office no longer needs your help; after all, you belong to administration.
Still, the chief editor's office really has too much work and should have expanded its staff long ago.
Boss, why not pick two seasoned producers from the other units and keep them here?
We cannot poach other people's staff; every department needs room to grow.
After training with Unit One, their people still need to return to their own departments.
Then what do we do about being short-staffed?
Is Kaiwen not back? Have Xiaogu intern under me first, and then have Kaiwen mentor her.
Mr Chun Yuqiao, may I really stay on in the chief editor's office?
Yes; close the door on your way out.
